title: Three Sermons, beginning at the latter end of the 21 Chapter of Geneſis, concerning Abrahams ſacrificing of his ſonne Izhak.

segments.text:
33 And Abraham planted a groue in Beerſheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the euerlasting God.
34 And Abraham was a ſtranger in the Philiſtims land a long ſeaſon.
